name: srsRAN 4G Docker Emulated
what_it_is: A minimal end-to-end srsRAN LTE system running in Docker containers with the air interface emulated via ZeroMQ. The core network (srsepc), base station (srsenb), and user device (srsue) each run in separate containers communicating over virtual RF and core networks.
protocols: GTP-U — user-plane tunneling between eNB and SPGW
ZeroMQ TCP sockets — emulated RF between eNB and UE
measurement: UE attachment confirmation and assigned IP (172.16.0.2 range)
ICMP ping latency from EPC to UE (~20-25 ms round-trip over emulated LTE)
Uplink scheduling latency indicator (~20 ms added latency vs direct Docker routing)
RRC state transitions (CONNECTED → IDLE after 1 minute of inactivity)
configuration: epc.conf — EPC (MME/SPGW) configuration; MME bind addr and SPGW GTP-U bind addr overridden via CLI flags
enb.conf — eNB configuration; MME addr, GTP bind addr, S1C bind addr overridden via CLI flags
sib.conf — System Information Block configuration for eNB
user_db.csv — IMSI/subscriber database for srsepc; add rows to provision additional UEs
ZeroMQ base sample rate: 23.04e6 sps (hardcoded in docker-compose command args)
fault_injection: fail_on_disconnect=true on eNB ZMQ device — eNB exits if RF link to UE drops
RRC IDLE triggered by 1 minute of data inactivity — causes random access and connection re-setup on next transmission
NAT masquerade removal on EPC eth0 disrupts UE internet routing through EPC
modes: Emulated RF mode (ZeroMQ TCP) — default; no physical radio hardware required
Multi-UE mode — optional second UE service described in README; requires additional IMSI in user_db.csv
Internet-routed-through-EPC mode — requires manual iptables MASQUERADE rule and default route change on UE
constraints: Requires Linux kernel with /dev/net/tun and NET_ADMIN capability — not runnable on plain macOS without a Linux VM
Only ZeroMQ (emulated) RF backend is configured; no SDR hardware passthrough in the compose file
UE internet access through EPC requires manual post-startup commands (iptables + ip route); not automated in compose
Single Dockerfile for all three services — all containers share the same image build context
docker-compose version 2.2 syntax used; incompatible with Compose V2 strict mode without adjustment
ZMQ base_srate fixed at 23.04e6 — changing bandwidth requires editing compose command args directly
docker_services: srsenb (virtual-srsenb) — corenet 10.80.95.11, rfnet 10.80.97.11; SYS_NICE cap; depends_on srsepc
srsue (virtual-srsue) — rfnet 10.80.97.10; NET_ADMIN + SYS_NICE caps; /dev/net/tun; depends_on srsenb
notable_absences: No SDR hardware passthrough or device mapping for real RF operation
No pre-built images — all services build from local Dockerfile at startup
No metrics/monitoring sidecar (no Grafana, Prometheus, or srsRAN metrics server)
No persistent volume mounts for logs or configuration overrides — config changes require image rebuild or Dockerfile ADD
No TLS or security configuration for S1 interface
